claims.reason: Trace-square similarity produces dim(H) Tr(T^2)>0; first trace is vacuous. Preserve proof exactly in recovery; live positive algebra can state the trace identity without promoting exclusion.
Unitary multiplication plus orthogonal full-irrep projection gives positive contraction D and shell support by fusion; both orientations hold.

claims.disposition: ACCEPT affirmative construction; DEFER wider negative certification
claims.reason: Schur orthogonality normalizes sqrt(d)g11^R; fixed right tensor e1^(R+1) places every output in Sym^(R+1), giving kernel and eigenvalue1. Explicit norm equality may survive as supplied-model identity; do not rename a universal exclusion as positive.
p+q=R minimizes energy at balanced labels, giving (R²-floor(R²/4)+3R)/a. R0 denominator zero is outside this estimate.

Projectors act trivially on color; each commutes with other-link transporters. PWP product identity and union bound give total INITIAL path kinetic energy/g, with arbitrary reference/color entanglement. No false mutual U commutation.
Acceptance p and normalized vector distance²=2(1-sqrt(p))<=2(1-p); preserve p>0 and initial cutoff support. No deterministic preparation claim.
State norm estimates do not supply unbounded kinetic-form approximation; full static-source trial is contextual, no import of its lower-bound coordinate theorem needed.

Haar integrals yield vacuum-F 1/sqrt3, F-A epsilon-product/2 from determinant integral1/6, A-vac delta/sqrt3. Matrix raw Gram spectrum15 ones42 zeros, shell support, covariance and witness independently checked.
Original scalar check did not exercise matrix. Literal Pv U Pv replacement is appropriate; analytic first Haar moment remains an input.
Historical reviews, inputs, cached outcomes and validation pins remain exact historical records, never current PASS or audit authority.
